item.content:encoded:
from: Quad9 Is Leaving France: Why DNS Resolvers Are the Wrong Place to Fight Piracy

On Tuesday, November 24, 2026, Quad9 will stop answering DNS queries from France. Quad9 is the Swiss non-profit behind the free 9.9.9.9 resolver, which blocks malware and phishing domains. It is not leaving because of costs or lack of users. It is leaving because a Paris court fined it for refusing to block a list of pirate sports-streaming domains on behalf of beIN Sports. With around 20 similar cases still pending in France, leaving the country is the only option Quad9 can afford.

2026 年 11 月 24 日（周二），Quad9 将停止响应来自法国的 DNS 查询。Quad9 是总部位于瑞士的非营利组织，运营着免费的 9.9.9.9 解析器，可拦截恶意软件和钓鱼域名。其退出并非因成本或用户不足，而是因为巴黎法院因其拒绝代表 beIN Sports 屏蔽一份盗版体育流媒体域名清单而对其处以罚款。鉴于法国还有约 20 起类似案件仍在审理中，离开该国是 Quad9 唯一负担得起的选择。

Cloudflare, which runs the competing 1.1.1.1 resolver, called the departure “a canary in the coal mine”, and the post reached the front page of Hacker News. In that thread, Quad9’s CTO John Todd asked readers to write “a long-form, well-reasoned statement of why France is taking the wrong path”, with plenty of sources, and to send it to policymakers. This is our attempt. Every claim below links to a primary document, a court ruling, or contemporaneous reporting.

Cloudflare, 运行竞争对手 1.1.1.1 解析器的 Cloudflare，将该离场称为 [“a canary in the coal mine”]，该帖子到达了 Hacker News 前页 (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50538994)。在这场讨论中，Quad9 首席技术官 John Todd 向读者 提出写 “a long-form, well-reasoned statement of why France is taking the wrong path”，包括充足的来源， 并发送给政策制定者。这是我们的尝试。每项主张均链接至原始文档、法院裁决或 当 contemporaneous reporting。

What Quad9 is, and why it matters

Quad9 是什么，以及它为何重要

A DNS resolver turns a name like example.com into an IP address your computer can connect to. Most people use their ISP’s resolver without knowing it. A public resolver is one anyone can point their device or network at instead, such as Google’s 8.8.8.8, Cloudflare’s 1.1.1.1, Cisco’s OpenDNS, or Quad9’s 9.9.9.9.

DNS resolver 将像 example.com 这样的名称转换为计算机可以连接的 IP 地址。大多数人在不知情的情况下使用其 ISP 的 resolver。公共 resolver 是任何人都可以将其设备或网络指向的替代 resolver，例如 Google 的 8.8.8.8、Cloudflare 的 1.1.1.1、Cisco 的 OpenDNS 或 Quad9 的 9.9.9.9。

Quad9 has a few properties that make it unusual:

Quad9 有几个属性使其不寻常：

  • It is a non-profit. It was founded in 2017 by the Global Cyber Alliance, IBM, and Packet Clearing House, and moved its legal seat to Zürich in 2021, hosted by SWITCH, specifically so that its privacy promises would be backed by Swiss law. As John Todd put it at the time: “Privacy policies which are not backed by law are empty promises.”
  • Security filtering is its main purpose. Quad9 refuses to resolve domains that threat-intelligence feeds flag as malware, phishing, or botnet infrastructure. Its about page claims 670 million+ blocks a day across 230+ resolver clusters in over 110 countries.
  • It keeps no user records. Quad9 does not know who its users are, and that is the point.
  • 它是一个非营利组织。 它由 Global Cyber Alliance、IBM 和 Packet Clearing House 于 2017 年创立，并于 2021 年将其法律实体迁至苏黎世，由 SWITCH 托管，旨在让其隐私承诺受瑞士法律保障。正如 John Todd 当时所言：“没有法律支撑的隐私政策只是空谈。”
  • 安全过滤是其核心目的。 Quad9 拒绝解析被威胁情报源标记为恶意软件、钓鱼网站或僵尸网络基础设施的域名。其关于页面声称 每天拦截 6.7 亿次以上，覆盖 110 多个国家的 230 多个解析器集群。
  • 它不保留任何用户记录。 Quad9 不知道其用户是谁，这正是其设计初衷。

Organisations have come to depend on it. Mullvad shut down its own public encrypted DNS service on November 2, 2026 and moved Mullvad Browser users with default settings to Quad9, funding Quad9 instead. (Mullvad Browser users in France will now be migrated to a resolver that disappears three weeks later.) Quad9’s announcement lists dozens of French networks it sees traffic from, including the interministerial digital directorate DINUM, France Travail, CEA, Institut Pasteur, RENATER, EDF, SNCF, AP-HM hospitals in Marseille, France Télévisions, Thales, and Airbus’s Stormshield. Quad9 can’t tell any of them it is leaving. As Cloudflare points out, when a resolver disappears, users don’t see an error message. “Their Internet will simply stop working.”

组织已经开始依赖它。 Mullvad shut down its own public encrypted DNS service on November 2, 2026 并将 Mullvad Browser 用户以默认设置 Quad9，资助 Quad9 代替。 （Mullvad Browser 用户在法国将现在被迁移到一个消失三周后的解析器。）Quad9 的公告列出了数十家法国网络的流量，其中包括 the interministerial digital directorate DINUM, France Travail, CEA, Institut Pasteur, RENATER, EDF, SNCF, AP-HM hospitals in Marseille, France Télévisions, Thales, and Airbus’s Stormshield. Quad9 can’t tell any of them it is leaving. As Cloudflare points out, when a resolver disappears, users don’t see an error message. “Their Internet will simply stop working.”

How France got here

法国是如何走到今天的

The law: Article L.333-10 of the Code du sport

法律依据：《体育法典》第 L.333-10 条

The legal basis for all of this is Article L.333-10 of the French sports code. It was created by Law 2021-1382 of October 25, 2021, the same law that merged HADOPI and the CSA into the new regulator Arcom. L.333-10 lets a sports rightsholder go to the president of the Paris judicial court and obtain “dynamic” blocking orders, meaning orders that cover sites already identified plus new mirror domains notified later through Arcom, against “toute personne susceptible de contribuer à y remédier” (any person able to help stop the infringement).

这一切的法律依据是 Article L.333-10 of the French sports code。它由 Law 2021-1382 of October 25, 2021 创设，该法律同将 HADOPI 和 CSA 合并为新监管机构 Arcom 。L.333-10 允许体育权利人向巴黎司法法院院长请求，获得“动态”阻断令，即覆盖已识别站点以及随后通过 Arcom 通知的新镜像域的令，针对“toute personne susceptible de contribuer à y remédier”（任何帮助遏制侵权的当事人）。

That last phrase is what puts DNS resolvers in scope. In July 2026, Parliament passed Law 2026-725 on professional sport, which amended L.333-10 and added an automated real-time blocking system run by Arcom. TorrentFreak reported that under the new system “ARCOM’s agents no longer approve each block in advance.” Quad9 called it “recklessly dangerous.”

该短语将 DNS 解析器纳入范围。在 七月 2026，议会通过了 Law 2026-725 on professional sport，该法修订了 L.333-10 并添加了由 Arcom 运行的实时自动阻断系统。TorrentFreak 报告 指出，在新系统下 “ Arcom’s agents no longer approve each block in advance”。 Quad9 称其为“ recklessly dangerous”。

The cases: from ISPs to everyone

案例：从 ISPs 到每个人

The timeline shows how the circle of targets has widened:

时间线展示了目标圈如何不断扩大：

Date What happened
Dec 2023 Canal+ sues Cloudflare, Google and Cisco under L.333-10 to force DNS blocking of football piracy sites.
May–Jun 2024 The Paris court orders the three resolvers to block ~117 domains. Google complies. Cisco pulls OpenDNS out of France on June 28, 2024, citing a court order “issued under Article L.333-10 of the French Sport code” (archived notice).
Sep–Oct 2024 New orders expand blocking by Google and Cloudflare.
Dec 2024 Canal+ wins three orders against Quad9 and Vercara (Premier League, Champions League, Top 14 rugby). Because it can’t geolocate users, Quad9 blocks the domains for the whole world: “we have to block these sites for all users, in all areas.”
May 2025 A beIN request against Google, Cloudflare and Quad9 is rejected for lack of evidence. Quad9 didn’t defend that case at all, citing lack of resources.
Mar 2026 The Paris Court of Appeal rejects five appeals by Google, Cloudflare and Cisco (RG 24/09372), the first appellate approval of DNS blocking under L.333-10: “Any filtering measure can be circumvented, and this possibility does not render the measures in question ineffective.” The same month, the court issues simultaneous orders against 19 ISPs, Google, Cloudflare, Quad9 and VPN providers.
Apr 2026 Canal+ obtains orders against Whalebone’s EU-funded DNS4EU resolver, which complies by blocking “globally across our resolver tiers.”
May 13, 2026 beIN Sports obtains an order (RG 26/02207) requiring Quad9 to block IPTV sites showing the WTA women’s tennis tour until the season ends on November 14. It starts with 6 domains and grows to 58 via Arcom notifications.
Jul 2026 14 new Canal+ orders for the 2026/27 season target ISPs, Google, Quad9, DNS4EU, Cloudflare, VPNs, and Bing.
Oct 7, 2026 The court refuses penalties against Cloudflare, NordVPN and Surfshark because each had made some effort to block. Cloudflare kept 1.1.1.1 out of it by acting through its CDN instead.
Oct 21, 2026 The court imposes a €1,000/day penalty on Quad9 (RG 26/11882).
Oct 22, 2026 Quad9 announces it will leave France on November 24.
日期 事件
2023 年 12 月 Canal+ 依据《法国体育法典》第 L.333-10 条，对 Cloudflare、Google 和 Cisco 提起诉讼，要求他们对足球盗版网站实施 DNS 拦截（链接）。
2024 年 5 月至 6 月 巴黎法院下令三家 DNS 解析服务商阻止约 117 个域名（链接）。 Google 服从了命令，而 Cisco 则于 2024 年 6 月 28 日退出法国市场，称其因法院依据《法国体育法典》第 L.333-10 条做出的裁决而必须撤出法国 OpenDNS 服务（存档通知）。
2024 年 9 月至 10 月 法院扩大了 Google 和 Cloudflare 的 DNS 拦截范围（链接）。
2024 年 12 月 Canal+ 赢得了三项针对 Quad9 和 Vercara 的诉讼（链接），涉及英超联赛、欧冠联赛和顶级14橄榄球赛事。由于无法 geolocate 用户，Quad9 不得不“在全球范围内为所有用户阻止这些网站”（链接）。
2025 年 5 月 法院驳回了 beIN 对 Google、Cloudflare 和 Quad9 的诉讼，认为缺乏证据（链接）。 Quad9 未能为该案进行任何辩护，称缺乏资源。
2026 年 3 月 巴黎上诉法院驳回了 Google、Cloudflare 和 Cisco 的五项上诉（RG 24/09372），这是首次在《法国体育法典》第 L.333-10 条项下批准 DNS 拦截的上诉裁决：“任何过滤措施都可以被规避，但这种可能性并不使相关措施无效。” 同月，法院对 19 家 ISP、Google、Cloudflare、Quad9 和 VPN 提供商发出同时生效的域名拦截令（链接）。
2026 年 4 月 Canal+ 获得法院令，要求 EU-funded DNS4EU 解析服务商 Whalebone 执行域名拦截，该公司通过“在全球范围内在其解析服务层级实施拦截”来遵守命令（链接）。
2026 年 5 月 13 日 beIN Sports 获得法院令（RG 26/02207），要求 Quad9 阻止播出 WTA 女子网球巡回赛的 IPTV 网站，直到该赛季结束（11 月 152016 日）。该命令最初涉及 6 个域名，后通过 Arcom 通知扩大到 58 个域名（链接）。
2026 年 7 月 巴黎法院为 2026/27 赛季发布 14 项针对 Canal+ 的域名拦截新令，涉及 ISP、Google、Quad9、DNS4EU、Cloudflare、 VPN 和 Bing 等服务提供商（链接）。
2026 年 10 月 7 日 法院拒绝对 Cloudflare、 NordVPN 和 Surfshark 施加 €10,000/天的罚款， 因为它们已采取了阻止措施。 Cloudflare 通过其 CDN 行动，使 1.1.1.1 避免参与拦截（链接）。
2026 年 10 月 21 日 法院对 Quad9 施加 €1,000/天的罚款（RG 26/11882）（链接）。
2026 年 10 月 22 日 Quad9 宣布将于 2026 年 11 月 24 日离开法国（链接）。

The ruling itself

裁决本身

The 21 October judgment is short and worth reading. A few details matter:

21 October judgment 短小精彩，值得阅读。几个细节很重要：

  • The €580,000 figure was beIN’s request, not the penalty. beIN asked for €10,000 per day per domain still reachable; across 58 domains that is €580,000 a day. The judge set €1,000 a day in total, running until the end of the WTA season on November 14.
  • The judge used Quad9’s malware filtering against it. Quad9 argued it could not implement geolocated blocking. The court (para. 16) replied that Quad9 “appears to contradict itself” because it already “applies automated filtering strictly limited to cybersecurity to neutralise malicious domains on a global scale.” The fact that a resolver can drop a name for everyone was treated as proof it can drop a name for France.
  • Refusing to try was enough. Paragraph 18: “Bound by an obligation of means, the Quad9 foundation states that it implements none in order to execute the decision. This circumstance alone justifies the imposition of a penalty.”
  • €580,000 的数字是 beIN 的请求，而非处罚。 beIN 要求每个仍可访问的域名每天 €10,000 per domain 仍可访问；跨 58 个域名总计为每天 €580,000。法官设定总计每天 €1,000，直至 WTA 赛季于 11 月 14 日结束。
  • 法官使用 Quad9 的恶意软件过滤对其进行拦截。 Quad9 认为其无法实现地理定位阻断。法院 (para. 16) 回应称 Quad9 “似乎自相矛盾”，因为它已经 “严格限于网络安全领域的自动过滤，以在全球范围内中和恶意域名。” 一个解析器可以为所有人丢弃一个名称，这被视为证明它可以为法国丢弃一个名称。
  • 拒绝尝试即可。 第 18段：“由于义务约束，Quad9 基金会表示其为执行决定而未实施任何措施。此情况单独就足以判处罚金。”

€1,000 a day for three weeks is survivable, about €24,000. Twenty more cases like it, each running for a full football season with ever-growing domain lists and Arcom’s new automated system feeding them, is not. Quad9 says: “Quad9 cannot survive the accumulation of penalties yet to be assessed in 20 other pending cases.”

每天 €1,000 持续三周是可以承受的，大约 €24,000。像这样的再有二十起案件，每个持续一个完整足球赛季，伴随着不断增长的域名列表以及 Arcom 新的自动化系统向其中注入数据，则无法承受。

Quad9 表示：“Quad9 无法承受其他 20 起待决案件中尚未评估的处罚累积。”

Why Quad9 can’t just comply

为什么 Quad9 不能仅仅遵守

Quad9 is often asked why it doesn’t just block the domains. It has three options, and none of them work.

Quad9 经常被问到为什么它没有仅仅阻断域名。它有三个选项，而且这些选项都没有起作用。

1. Block globally. This is what Quad9 did for Canal+ in December 2024 and what DNS4EU does today. It means a French court decides what a user in Brazil, Kenya or Germany can resolve, for the commercial benefit of one company. Quad9’s announcement asks how France would react if other nations imposed their laws on French users through DNS. The answer is obvious, and the reverse should be too. Nothing limits this to sports either: once global blocking is accepted, every court in every country can add names to everyone’s resolver.

1. 全局封锁。 这正是 Quad9 在 2024 年 12 月为 Canal+ 所做的事情，也是 DNS4EU 如今在做的事情。这意味着一家法国法院就能决定，身处巴西、肯尼亚或德国的用户可以解析哪些内容，而这一切都是为了某一家公司的商业利益。Quad9 的公告反问：如果其他国家通过 DNS 将本国的法律强加于法国用户，法国会作何反应？答案显而易见，反过来同样如此。

这种逻辑也绝不限于体育赛事：一旦全局封锁被接受，那么每一个国家的每一家法院都可以把域名添加进所有人的解析器中。

2. Geo-block France. Quad9 has already tried this, in Germany. In the Sony Music v. Quad9 case, Quad9 used geoIP blocking for German users while the case continued. Sony’s lawyers used a VPN to reach the content “from Germany” anyway, the court agreed this was non-compliance, and Quad9 was fined for contempt. GeoIP is a probabilistic guess about where an IP address is, not a legal fact about where a person is. A resolver that keeps no user records has no reliable way to define a “French user.” As Quad9 told TorrentFreak: “There is no legally useful way for us to define a French user.” Even the French order is geographically complicated: heise notes it covers the overseas departments and Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon but excludes New Caledonia, Wallis and Futuna, and French Polynesia.

2. Geo-block France. Quad9 已经在德国尝试过这一点。在 Sony Music v. Quad9 case 中，Quad9 在案件继续期间对德国用户使用了 geoIP 阻塞。Sony 的律师无论如何都使用 VPN 从 “from Germany” 访问了内容，法院同意这属于不合规，Quad9 因此因藐视法庭被罚款。GeoIP 是对 IP 地址位置的概率性猜测，而非关于人身所在地的法律事实。一个不保留用户记录的 resolver 没有可靠的方式来定义 “French user”。正如 Quad9 told TorrentFreak 所说：“我们没有在法律上有用的方式来定义 French user。” 即使是法国命令在地理上也很复杂：heise notes 它涵盖海外省和 Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon，但不包括 New Caledonia、Wallis and Futuna 和 French Polynesia。

3. Pay and fight. Quad9 won in Germany. The Dresden Higher Regional Court held in December 2023 that DNS resolvers get the same liability privilege as access providers, and the German civil rights group GFF said “the judgement puts the onus on rights holders.” But winning took “several years, six figures of cost to Quad9, and massive wasted time,” and the opposition, in Quad9’s words, “has more lawyers than we have money and time.” As Quad9 wrote in 2025, compliance costs that are routine overhead for Google are, “for small, mission-driven nonprofits like Quad9, … an existential threat.”

3. 付费与抗争。 Quad9 在德国胜诉。德累斯顿高等区域法院 在 2023 年 12 月 认定，DNS 解析器 获得与 接入提供商 相同的责任特权，德国民权组织 GFF 表示：“该判决将负担放在权利持有人身上。”但胜诉花费了“几年、Quad9 六位数的成本，以及大量浪费的时间，”并且，用 Quad9 的话说，反对方“律师比我们的钱和时间都多。”正如 Quad9 在 2025 年 撰文 所述，对 Google 而言属于常规开销的合规成本，“对于像 Quad9 这样的小型、使命驱动的非营利组织……是一个生存威胁。”

That leaves leaving.

那就只剩下离开了。

Why DNS blocking doesn’t work

为什么 DNS 阻塞不起作用

DNS 阻塞是网络层过滤的常见方法，但它存在根本局限性，在许多实际场景中表现失效。当用户输入被阻塞的域名时，请求会发送到 DNS 解析器，后者随后返回表明该域名无法解析的响应。然而 DoH (DNS over HTTPS) 和加密 DNS 等功能可以绕过简单的阻塞机制，因此 DNS 阻塞在不同网络环境中无法一致地强制执行策略。

The argument against resolver blocking isn’t only about Quad9’s survival. Even on its own terms, it does not do what the rightsholders want.

反对解析器封锁的论点并不仅仅关乎 Quad9 的存亡。即便仅就其本身而言，这种做法也无法实现权利持有人的诉求。

It doesn’t remove anything. The DNS only holds pointers. Quad9’s Dresden write-up puts it this way: “The DNS does not contain content - it is a system designed for delivery only of pointers.” The pirate server stays online and keeps serving everyone who reaches it some other way. The Internet Society’s 2025 guide for legal professionals says the same thing.

它不会删除任何东西。 DNS 只存储指向信息的指针。Quad9 的 德累斯顿案例分析 中提到：“DNS 不存储内容，它是一个仅用于传递指针的系统。” 盗版服务器仍然在线，并继续通过其他方式为访问者提供服务。互联网协会的 2025 年法律专业人士指南 也给出了同样的解释。

It takes seconds to bypass. Quad9 notes there are thousands of other open resolvers. Users can also run their own, or use encrypted DNS over HTTPS (RFC 8484), which looks like ordinary web traffic. Arcom’s own December 2025 study for the National Assembly says 20% of French internet users already use an alternative DNS resolver and 29% use a VPN. Quad9 compares DNS blocking to “holding a piece of newspaper in front of a stadium full of people to block the view of a concert.”

只需几秒即可绕过。 Quad9 指出还有数千个其他开放解析器。用户也可以自行搭建，或使用加密的 DNS over HTTPS (RFC 8484)，其流量外观与普通 Web 流量无异。Arcom 为国民议会编写的 2025 年 12 月研究报告显示，20% 的法国互联网用户已在使用替代 DNS 解析器，29% 在使用 VPN。Quad9 将 DNS 封锁比作“在满座的体育场观众面前举起一张报纸，试图挡住他们观看演唱会的视线。”

It is blunt. DNS works at the level of whole domains. A resolver can’t block one infringing stream on a shared host without blocking everything else on that name. The IAB’s RFC 7754, the IETF’s standard reference on blocking and filtering, says: “From a technical perspective, there are no perfect or even good solutions – there is only least bad.” ICANN’s security committee revisited the question in SAC127, “DNS Blocking Revisited” (2025), warning implementers to minimise overblocking and avoid affecting users outside their jurisdiction. France’s own registry operator, AFNIC, made the core point years ago in its scientific council’s report on the consequences of DNS filtering: “Le DNS n’a pas été conçu pour filtrer les contenus.” (The DNS was not designed to filter content.)

DNS过滤是粗糙的。 DNS 在整域名级别运行。解析器无法在共享主机上拦截单条侵权流，而不屏蔽该名称下的所有其他内容。IAB 的 RFC 7754（IETF 关于阻塞和过滤的标准参考）指出：“从技术角度来看，不存在完美的、甚至是好的解决方案——只有最不坏的方案。”ICANN 的安全委员会在 SAC127，“重新审视 DNS 阻塞”（2025 年）中重新审视了这一问题，警告实施者尽量减少过度阻塞，并避免影响其司法管辖区之外的用户。法国自己的注册管理机构 AFNIC 多年前在其关于 DNS 过滤的后果 的科学委员会报告中就指出了核心要点：“Le DNS n’a pas été conçu pour filtrer les contenus.”（DNS 并非设计用于过滤内容。）

It is opaque. When a resolver is forced to lie, the user sees a site that doesn’t load. They have no way to tell whether the site is down, their network is broken, or a court ordered the block. There is a standard for being honest about this: RFC 8914 Extended DNS Errors defines code 16, “Censored”, for answers withheld “due to an external requirement imposed by an entity other than the operator.” But nothing in the French orders requires resolvers to use it.

它是不透明的。 当解析器被迫说谎时，用户会看到一个无法加载的站点。他们无法判断站点是 down 还是网络出了问题，或者是法院下令的屏蔽。关于这一点有一个诚实的标准：RFC 8914 Extended DNS Errors 定义了代码 16， “Censored”，用于因“实体（非运营方）施加的外部要求”而被扣留的答案。但法国的命令中什么也没要求解析器使用它。

Blocking at scale causes real collateral damage. France is not the only test case. Italy’s Piracy Shield system blocked Google Drive for much of the country in October 2024. A of Piracy Shield found more than 500 unrelated sites blocked and concluded that “IP-level blocking is an indiscriminate tool with consequences that outweigh its benefits.” In Spain, LaLiga’s IP blocking of shared Cloudflare addresses knocked innocent sites offline every match day, leading Cloudflare’s CEO Matthew Prince to call the approach “bonkers”. The same RIPE study found most European piracy is hosted in Europe, which is where enforcement belongs: at the hosting provider.

大规模屏蔽会造成真实的连带损害。 法国并非唯一的案例。意大利的 Piracy Shield 系统在 2024 年 10 月让全国大部分地区无法访问 Google Drive。对 Piracy Shield 的 A 发现，有超过 500 个无关网站被屏蔽，并得出结论称"IP 层面的屏蔽是一种不加区分的手段，其后果超过了它带来的好处"。在西班牙，LaLiga 对 Cloudflare 共享 IP 地址的屏蔽，导致每个比赛日都有无辜网站被迫下线，这使得 Cloudflare 首席执行官 Matthew Prince 将该做法称为 “bonkers”。同一项 RIPE 研究发现，欧洲的大部分盗版内容托管在欧洲，而这正是执法应当发生的地方：在托管服务商处。

Measured by its own goals, the French system has a mixed record. Arcom reports 12,606 sports domains blocked since 2022, 6,496 of them in 2025 alone (up 71%), while piracy fell 4% in 2025 and 34% since 2021. The number of blocks is growing much faster than piracy is shrinking, and Arcom’s figures don’t separate the effect of resolver blocking from ISP blocking. Every one of those domains has to be found, blocked, and then found again when it reappears under a new name. OONI’s 2025 measurement of French ISP blocking found that of 542 domains tested, 291 were blocked by at least one ISP but only 132 by all four. The European Commission’s own 2025 assessment of its live-events piracy recommendation concluded the effects “have been limited and have not allowed to significantly curb the volume of online piracy of live events.”

以其自身目标衡量，法国体系的表现喜忧参半。Arcom 报告称，自 2022 年以来已有 12,606 个体育域名被封禁，仅 2025 年就有 6,496 个（增长 71%），而 2025 年盗版下降了 4%，自 2021 年以来下降了 34%。封禁数量的增长速度远快于盗版减少的速度，而 Arcom 的数据并未区分 resolver 封禁与 ISP 封禁各自的效果。每一个此类域名都必须先被发现、被封禁，之后当其以新名称重新出现时又必须再次被发现。OONI 的 2025 年法国 ISP 封禁测量发现，在测试的 542 个域名中，291 个至少被一个 ISP 封禁，但仅有 132 个被全部四家 ISP 封禁。欧盟委员会对其现场赛事盗版 建议的自身 2025 年评估得出结论：效果“有限，未能显著遏制现场赛事在线盗版的数量”。

What France loses

法国失去什么？

Driving Quad9 out of France doesn’t hurt pirates at all. The people who lose are the ones who chose a resolver for security.

将 Quad9 逐出法国对盗版者毫无影响。真正受损的是那些出于安全考虑而选择该解析器的用户。

  • French users lose a malware filter. Quad9 exists to stop people resolving phishing and malware domains. Users who move to an unfiltered resolver, or to their ISP’s resolver, lose that protection. Users who move to an unknown free resolver may be trading it for one that sells their browsing data. As Cloudflare puts it, “Penalizing transparent services only pushes users toward less accountable corners of the web.”
  • Critical infrastructure may break silently. Hospitals, utilities and local authorities on Quad9’s list will lose DNS if their IT teams miss the announcement. Embedded devices with 9.9.9.9 hard-coded may be hard to fix.
  • The choice of resolvers shrinks. OpenDNS left France in 2024, and Quad9 leaves now. An Internet Society report cited by TorrentFreak warned that small and non-profit resolvers are the most likely to be pushed out, leaving the field to the largest companies, which can afford to fight or to build per-country infrastructure. Cloudflare can satisfy the court by blocking at its CDN; Quad9 has only a resolver.
  • France’s own digital sovereignty goals suffer. France promotes privacy-respecting European infrastructure, yet its courts are driving out a Swiss privacy-focused non-profit while US giants remain.
  • 法国用户失去了一个恶意软件过滤器。 Quad9 旨在阻止人们解析钓鱼和恶意软件域名。移动到未过滤的解析器，或移动到其 ISP 的解析器，的用户将失去该保护。移动到未知免费解析器的人可能会 用一个出售他们浏览数据的去交换。正如 Cloudflare 所说，“惩罚透明服务只会把用户推向网络中不太负责任的角落。”
  • 关键基础设施可能被静默破坏。 位于 Quad9 列表中的医院、公用事业和地方当局如果其 IT 团队漏掉了公告，将失去 DNS。带有硬编码 9.9.9.9 的嵌入式设备可能难以修复。
  • 解析器的选择会减少。 OpenDNS 于 2024 年离开法国，而 Quad9 现在也离开了。Internet Society 的一份报告 据 TorrentFreak 报道 警告称，小型和非营利性解析器最有可能被推动出去，剩下领域将由最大的公司占据，这些公司可以负担得起战斗或建设按国家基础设施。Cloudflare 可以通过在其 CDN 中进行阻止来满足法院；而 Quad9 只有一个解析器。
  • 法国自身的数字主权目标也会受影响。 法国虽然推广尊重隐私的欧洲基础设施，却让其法院驱逐了专注隐私的瑞士非营利组织，而美国巨头仍然存在。

It’s not just France

这不仅仅是法国

Quad9 is the clearest casualty so far, but the same process is underway across Europe.

Quad9 是目前唯一明确的受害者，但同样的情况正在整个欧洲蔓延。

  • Belgium: DAZN obtained an order against Cloudflare, Google and Cisco in March 2025, and OpenDNS left Belgium in April 2025 before returning when the order against Cisco was suspended. In August 2026, the Brussels business court upheld the core of the order, with fines of €100,000 per match day capped at €20 million per company. Cisco says its public DNS “does not allow for the implementation of selective, geolocated and dynamic blocking as required by the order.” Cloudflare, Google and Cisco have appealed ahead of the January 2027 deadline.
  • Italy: AGCOM fined Cloudflare €14.2 million in January 2026, 1% of its global revenue, for not blocking via 1.1.1.1. Prince threatened to pull servers and free services from Italy: “Play stupid games, win stupid prizes.”
  • Spain: A Barcelona court upheld LaLiga’s right to block Cloudflare IP addresses.
  • Germany is the counter-example. Courts there rejected resolver blocking for both Quad9 and Cloudflare.
  • The EU level: A study commissioned by the European Parliament’s legal affairs committee proposes a binding regulation that would require blocking within 30 minutes across DNS resolvers, VPNs and CDNs. John Todd’s warning on Hacker News is that “the EU and EC are looking at this issue right now and I expect will look to France as a case study of how to do things for the rest of the region.”
  • 比利时： DAZN 于 2025 年 3 月取得针对 Cloudflare、Google 和 Cisco 的命令；2025 年 4 月，OpenDNS 退出比利时，随后在对 Cisco 的命令被暂停后恢复。2026 年 8 月，布鲁塞尔商事法院维持了该命令的核心内容，其中每个比赛日罚款 10 万欧元，每家公司上限为 2000 万欧元。Cisco 表示，其公共 DNS“无法实现该命令所要求的、具有选择性、基于地理位置且动态的屏蔽。”Cloudflare、Google 和 Cisco 已在 2027 年 1 月的截止日期前提出上诉。
  • 意大利： AGCOM 于 2026 年 1 月对 Cloudflare 罚款 1420 万欧元，相当于其全球收入的 1%，原因是通过 1.1.1.1 未进行屏蔽。Prince 威胁要从意大利撤出服务器和免费服务：“犯蠢，就得承担蠢后果。”
  • 西班牙： 一家巴塞罗那法院维持了 LaLiga 的权利，即屏蔽 Cloudflare IP 地址。
  • 德国是反例。那里的法院驳回了针对 Quad9 和 Cloudflare 的解析器屏蔽。
  • 欧盟层面： 欧洲议会法律事务委员会委托的一项研究提出了一项具有约束力的法规，要求在 DNS 解析器、VPN 和 CDN 上于 30 分钟内实施屏蔽。John Todd 在 Hacker News 上的警告是：“欧盟和欧盟委员会目前正关注这一问题，我预计它们会把法国作为案例研究，看看如何为其他地区落实相关做法。”

That is why France matters beyond France. If its model becomes the EU template, every public resolver in Europe will face the choice Quad9 faced: lie to all users worldwide, build unreliable geolocation infrastructure, or leave.

正因为法国在法国之外依然重要。 如果它的模型成为欧盟模板，欧洲的每一位公共解决者将面临 Quad9 所面临的选择：向全世界用户撒谎、构建不可靠的定位基础设施，或者离开。

The counter-arguments

反驳意见

The Hacker News discussion wasn’t one-sided, and the counter-arguments deserve answers.

Hacker News 讨论并非单方面，反驳理据值得回应.

“Hosting providers are unreachable, so courts move up the chain.” One commenter argued that pirate hosts are bulletproof and ignore courts, so going after the intermediaries is the only lever left. Another asked the Quad9 CTO directly where the problem should be attacked. This is the strongest point. But the RIPE data shows most of the hosting is in Europe and within reach of European courts, and the commenter’s logic leads to blocking at the last link in the chain that cannot fight back. That is not the same as the link that can actually stop the infringement.

主机提供商不可达，法院向上移动链条。 One commenter 认为海盗主机是防弹的并且忽视法院，因此针对中间商是唯一剩下的杠杆。 Another 直接向Quad9 CTO提问，问题应该在哪里攻击。这是最强的论点。但RIPE数据显示大部分主机位于欧洲，且在欧洲法院的管辖范围内，评论者的逻辑导致在链条上最后一环被阻断，而这正是不能反击的环节。这与实际能够遏止侵权的环节不同。

“Friction works. Most people won’t bother to switch.” Some argued that DNS blocking is good because it nudges the majority while staying easy to bypass for those who know how. The Paris Court of Appeal used essentially this reasoning. But Arcom’s numbers say a fifth of French users already use alternative DNS, the friction is gone the moment one person changes a router setting for a household, and the cost is paid by resolvers that never had anything to do with piracy.

“摩擦是有效的。大多数人不会费心切换。” 有人主张 认为 DNS 屏蔽是好的，因为 它会推动大多数人，同时对于知道怎么做的人来说仍然容易绕过。巴黎上诉法院基本上采用了同样的理由。但 Arcom 的数据显示，五分之一的法国用户已经在使用替代 DNS，只要家庭中有一个人更改了路由器设置，摩擦就会消失，而代价由与盗版毫无关系的解析器承担。

“Cloudflare is a hypocrite.” Several commenters pointed out that Cloudflare’s CDN fronts many pirate sites. That may be true, and it is an argument about Cloudflare’s CDN, which French courts can already reach and have. It says nothing about whether a resolver should lie.

Cloudflare 是一个伪君子。 几位评论者指出， Cloudflare 的 CDN 为许多盗版网站提供支持。这或许是真的，这是一个关于 Cloudflare CDN 的争论，法国法院已经可以（并且已经）对它进行裁决。但这并不能说明一个解析器是否应该说谎。

“The yellow pages would be held responsible.” One commenter asked whether we’d accept a phone directory that kept listing a drug dealer’s new address. The analogy fails because a resolver is not a curated directory. It’s closer to the operator who connects you to whatever number you dial. Quad9 has “no association with these domain names, nor with the operators of the websites.” Making the operator liable for every number dialled is how you end up with no operator.

“黄页也会因此被追究责任。” 一位评论者问道，我们能否接受一本不断刊登毒贩新地址的电话簿。这个类比并不成立，因为 resolver 并非一份经过人工整理编排的目录。它更接近接线员——无论你拨的是什么号码，都负责为你接通。Quad9 表示，它"与这些域名，以及与这些网站的运营者均无关联"。让接线员为用户拨打的每一个号码承担责任，最终的结果就是再没有人愿意做接线员。

What you can do

您可以做什么

If you use Quad9 in France, check whether you do at on.quad9.net, and switch resolvers before November 24. Check routers, VPN configs, DHCP settings, Pi-hole upstreams, and any devices with 9.9.9.9 or 149.112.112.112 hard-coded. Whatever you switch to, read its privacy policy first.

如果您在法国使用 Quad9，请访问 on.quad9.net 检查您是否在使用它，并在 11 月 24 日之前切换解析器。检查路由器、VPN 配置、DHCP 设置、Pi-hole 上游服务器，以及任何硬编码了 9.9.9.9 或 149.112.112.112 的设备。无论您切换到什么解析器，请先阅读其隐私政策。

If you’re in France or the EU, do what John Todd asked: write something long-form, ideally in French, make it indexable, and send it to your representatives. Quad9 specifically suggests telling Arcom that its mandate is to balance rightsholders’ interests against citizens’ digital rights, and that “balance cannot be claimed when the privacy and security of digital users are the collateral damage.”

如果你在法国或欧盟, 按照 John Todd 的要求：write something long-form, 理想地用法语，使其可被索引，并发送给你们的代表。Quad9 具体建议 告知 Arcom，其使命是平衡 rightsholders’ 利益与公民的数字权利，并且 “balance cannot be claimed when the privacy and security of digital users are the collateral damage.”

If you work on infrastructure, push for transparency wherever blocking does happen. RFC 8914’s “Censored” error code exists so users can tell a court-ordered block from a broken network.

如果你从事基础设施工作，请在发生阻塞时推动透明度。RFC 8914 的 “Censored” 错误代码，旨在让用户能够区分法院命令施加的封锁与网络故障。

If you can afford it, Quad9 accepts donations for its legal defence. Its appeal against the May order is still pending at the Paris Court of Appeal.

如果负担得起，Quad9 接受用于其法律辩护的捐款。其针对五月命令的上诉仍在巴黎上诉法院待审。

The canary

金丝雀

Quad9 put it this way: “Once the tools of censorship are built, they are rarely used sparingly or justly.” The French system started with football. It now covers tennis, rugby, MotoGP and Formula 1, has expanded from ISPs to resolvers, VPNs, CDNs and search engines, and runs through an automated system in which no human approves each block. Each step was reasonable on its own. Together, they have pushed a non-profit security service out of the country while the piracy continues.

Quad9 put it this way: “一旦 审查工具 被 构建，它们 就 很少 被 节制地 或 公正地 使用”。 法国 系统 最初 从 足球 开始。它 现在 覆盖 网球、 橄榄球、 MotoGP 和 Formula 1，已 从 ISP 扩展到 解析器、 VPNs、 CDNs 和 搜索引擎，并 通过 一个 自动化 系统，其中 没有人 类 审核 每个 封禁。每 一 步 单独 看 都 合情合理。合起来，它们 推出 了 非营利 安全 服务 出国，而 盗版 持续 进行。

The sports-rights industry has a real problem. DNS resolvers are the wrong place to solve it, and France is about to find out what the internet looks like when the trustworthy resolvers leave first.

体育版权行业面临着一个棘手的问题。DNS 解析器并非解决该问题的恰当场所，而法国即将亲身体验当可信解析器率先离场时，互联网会变成什么样。

item.content:encoded:
from: Google's AI Overviews cut clicks to websites by 40%

Google’s AI answers are taking clicks from websites in the search results. In a randomized experiment, researchers hid AI Overviews from some US desktop users. Comparing them with users who still saw Overviews shows that an Overview cuts clicks to outside websites by about 40%. Those Overviews now appear on more than half the US keywords DataForSEO tracks, up from 6% two years ago. The industry’s answer, GEO (generative engine optimization), has yet to show a way to compensate for the loss. While AI citations correlate with the same kind of link profile that goes with higher Google rankings, in March AI assistants sent websites just 0.3% of their traffic.

Google 的 AI 答案正在从搜索结果中的网站抢走点击。在一项随机实验中，研究人员对某些美国桌面用户隐藏了 AI Overviews。将这些用户与仍然看到 Overviews 的用户进行比较，结果表明，一个 Overview 会使站外网站的点击量减少约 40%。如今，这些 Overviews 出现在 DataForSEO 跟踪的美国关键词中，覆盖率超过一半，而两年前这一比例为 6%。行业给出的答案是 GEO（生成式引擎优化），但至今仍未找到弥补这一损失的方法。尽管 AI 引用与通常与更高 Google 排名相关联的同类链接画像存在相关性，但在 3 月，AI 助手为网站带来的流量仅占网站总流量的 0.3%。

Search engine optimization (SEO) still decides whether you can be found, but where an AI answer appears, a ranking brings 40% fewer visits than it used to. Generative engine optimization (GEO), the practice of getting your content cited in AI-written answers, looks mostly like SEO plus two additions: being present on the third-party sites AI answers draw from, and writing pages that are easy to quote. We found little evidence for any other tactic.

搜索引擎优化 (SEO) 仍决定你是否能被发现，但当 AI 回答出现时，排名带来的访问量比以前少了 40 %。生成引擎优化 (GEO) 是将你的内容在 AI 生成的答案中被引用的实践，整体上大体相当于 SEO 加上两项补充：在 AI 答案中引用的第三方网站上有所存在，以及编写易于引用的页面。我们发现几乎没有其他策略的证据。

Google answers first

Google 优先回答

An AI Overview is a generated summary that Google places above the ordinary results, with links to the pages it drew on. In DataForSEO’s monthly panel of 20 million keywords, the share of results showing one climbed from 5.93% in September 2024 to 61.43% in August 2026. The chart at the top of this post shows that climb. Over the same period the featured snippet, the quoted passage Google used to show at the top of a page, fell from 8.96% to 0.44%, and the discussions and forums block fell from 21.13% to 7.42%. Video results rose from 9.67% to 19.98%, though that is down from a peak of 31.05% in October 2025, and local map listings rose from 19.98% to 25.99%. DataForSEO’s dataset covers 190 million keywords, 165 million AI answers, and 1.1 billion backlinks, mostly for US English searches. Pew Research Center’s data gives an independent check. Pew logged the searches of 900 US adults in March 2025, re-ran them in April, and found summaries on 18% of them. DataForSEO’s figures for those months are 14.67% and 17.63%, close to Pew’s.

AI Overview 是 Google 放置在普通结果上方的生成摘要，并附带其引用页面的链接。在 DataForSEO 的 monthly panel of 20 million keywords 中，显示 AI Overview 的结果占比从 2024 年 9 月的 5.93% 上升至 2026 年 8 月的 61.43%。本帖顶部的图表展示了这一增长趋势。

在同一时期，featured snippet（Google 过去用于在页面顶部展示的引用段落）的占比从 8.96% 下降至 0.44%，discussions and forums block 的占比从 21.13% 下降至 7.42%。Video results 从 9.67% 上升至 19.98%，尽管这一数值低于 2025 年 10 月的峰值 31.05%；local map listings 从 19.98% 上升至 25.99%。

What happens to the clicks

点击都会经历什么

The strongest evidence is an experiment. Saharsh Agarwal and Ananya Sen gave US desktop Chrome users an extension that put each of them at random into a group. One group saw Google as usual, and another had AI Overviews hidden. The researchers then watched two weeks of real searches in January and February 2026. On searches that would show an Overview, the group that could see them averaged 0.37 clicks to outside websites per search, against 0.62 for the group that couldn’t, which the authors report as a 39.8% reduction. Searches ending with no outbound click went from 54% to 73%. Clicks on ads didn’t change, which suggests Google takes care not to cannibalize its own revenue. Across all searches, with and without an Overview, the authors put the loss at roughly 18.5% of the organic clicks a site gets from Google. The authors expect the loss to grow as Overviews appear on more searches. This is a randomized controlled trial, the most reliable kind of study for separating cause from correlation or coincidence. The effect was statistically significant for informational searches. The navigational and transactional samples were too small to settle anything. This is a working paper, not yet peer reviewed, and it covers desktop only. A separate preregistered experiment by Wang and colleagues, with 1,100 people, also found that removing AI Overviews and AI Mode raised clicks to publishers.

最有力的证据来自一项实验。Saharsh Agarwal 和 Ananya Sen 向美国桌面 Chrome 用户提供了一个扩展程序，将他们随机分配到不同的组中。一组用户像往常一样看到 Google，另一组则隐藏了 AI Overviews。研究人员随后观察了 2026 年 1 月和 2 月期间两周的真实搜索情况。在会显示 AI Overviews 的搜索中，能够看到它们的组平均每次搜索点击外部网站 0.37 次，而无法看到的组为 0.62 次，作者报告这相当于减少了 39.8%。没有产生任何外部点击的搜索比例从 54% 上升到了 73%。广告点击量没有变化，这表明 Google 注意避免蚕食自身的收入。在所有搜索中（无论是否显示 AI Overviews），作者估计损失约为网站从 Google 获得的自然点击量的 18.5%。作者预计，随着 AI Overviews 出现在更多的搜索中，这一损失还会进一步扩大。

这是一项随机对照试验（randomized controlled trial），是区分因果关系与相关性或巧合的最可靠的研究类型。对于信息型搜索（informational searches），该效应在统计学上是显著的。导航型（navigational）和交易型（transactional）样本量太小，无法得出任何定论。这是一份工作论文（working paper），尚未经过同行评审，且仅涵盖桌面端。Wang 及其同事进行的另一项涉及 1,100 人的预先注册实验也发现，移除 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 会增加出版商获得的点击量。

Observational data points the same way. Pew found people clicked an ordinary result on 8% of visits to a results page with a summary and on 15% without one, and ended their browsing session on 26% against 16%. Pew’s comparison isn’t a controlled experiment, because the searches that draw a summary tend to be longer and phrased as questions.

观察性数据也指向了同样的方向。皮尤研究发现，当结果页面中存在摘要时，用户点击普通结果的比例为8%，而无摘要时则为15%。此外，在有摘要的情况下，用户结束浏览的比例为26%，无摘要时为16%。皮尤研究所的比较并非受控实验，因为产生摘要的搜索通常更长且以疑问句的形式呈现。

Mobile fell from 25.17% to 20.80%, a drop of 17%.

GEO looks mostly like SEO

GEO 看起来很像 SEO

Google’s position is that there are “no additional requirements to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode, nor other special optimizations necessary”, beyond a page being indexed and eligible to show with a snippet. Since that is a company describing its own product, we looked at outside data on two questions. The first is which sites get considered, and the second is which page on a site gets picked.

Google 的立场是，除了页面被收录并有资格带摘要展示之外，“出现在 AI Overviews 或 AI Mode 中无需额外要求，也无需其他特殊优化”。由于这是 Google 对其自身产品的描述，我们查阅了外部数据来回答两个问题。第一是哪些站点会被纳入考虑，第二是站点中的哪个页面会被选中。

Which sites: link profiles correlate with citations

哪些网站：link profiles 与 citations 相关

A referring domain is another website that links to yours. DataForSEO measured how closely referring domains track AI citations using Spearman’s correlation, a score where 0 means no relationship between two rankings and 1 means they match exactly. The score was 0.406 for AI Overviews and 0.377 for ChatGPT. Links marked as coming from user-generated content, such as forum posts, scored lower, at 0.342 and 0.314.

referring domain 是另一个链接到你的网站的网站。 DataForSEO 测量了referring domains 如何密切跟踪 AI citations 使用 Spearman’s correlation， 0 表示两个排名之间没有关系， 1 表示完全匹配。 分数 为 AI Overviews 的 0.406 与 ChatGPT 的 0.377。 user-generated content 标记的链接， forum posts， 得分更低， 为 0.342 和 0.314。

These are moderate relationships, and they don’t show that links cause citations, since large, well-known sites tend to have more of everything. The samples also contain only domains cited at least once, so they can’t tell you what it takes to get cited for the first time. A similar pattern shows up in ordinary rankings: domains ranking first had a median of 111 referring domains against 85 for positions 4 to 10, with heavy overlap between the groups. For AI Overviews, the median cited domain had 282 referring domains on the easiest keywords and 1,571 on the hardest, after the report excluded giant platforms like YouTube and Amazon and any domain with fewer than 50 referring domains. Small sites weren’t measured at all. The ranges are also wide, at 518 to 5,765 for the middle half of domains on the hardest keywords, so sites with very different link profiles get cited.

这些是中等程度的相关关系，并不能证明链接会导致引用，因为大型知名网站往往在所有方面都拥有更多。样本中也只包含至少被引用过一次的域名，因此无法告诉你首次获得引用需要什么条件。类似的模式也出现在普通排名中：排名第一的域名的 referring domains（引荐域名）中位数为 111，而第 4 至第 10 位为 85，两组之间存在大量重叠。对于 AI Overviews，在报告排除了 YouTube 和 Amazon 等大型平台以及引荐域名少于 50 个的域名后，被引用域名的引荐域名中位数在最简单关键词上为 282，在最难关键词上为 1,571。小型网站完全未被纳入测量。范围也很宽：在最难关键词上，中间一半域名的范围为 518 至 5,765，因此链接构成差异极大的网站也会被引用。

Which page: cited pages often don’t rank for the query

哪个页面：被引用的页面常不因查询而排名

Ranking for a query and being cited for it are drifting apart. Ahrefs found 76% of pages cited in AI Overviews ranked in the top 10 for that query in July 2025, and about 38% in March 2026. The two studies differ in sample, parsing, and the Gemini model behind the Overviews, so the size of that fall isn’t a clean measurement. One possible mechanism is what Google calls query fan-out: its documentation says these features may issue “multiple related searches across subtopics and data sources”. A page could then be cited because it ranks for a related question the reader never typed. Ahrefs offers this only as a possibility, and its earlier study tested the idea and found that the data didn’t support it.

针对某个查询的排名和被引用正在逐渐脱钩。Ahrefs 发现，在 2025 年 7 月 的研究中，AI Overviews 引用的页面中有 76% 在该查询中排名前 10，而 2026 年 3 月 的研究中这一比例约为 38%。这两项研究在样本、解析方式以及 Overviews 背后的 Gemini 模型方面存在差异，因此无法精确衡量这一降幅的大小。一种可能的机制是 Google 所谓的 query fan-out（查询发散）：其文档指出，这些功能可能会"跨子主题和数据源发起多次相关搜索"。这样一来，一个页面可能因为其在读者从未输入过的相关问题上的排名而被引用。Ahrefs 仅将其作为一种可能性提出，其早期的研究对此进行了验证，发现数据并不支持该假设。

The most careful test of page-level tactics we found is a study by the SEO software company SISTRIX, published in October 2026. It paired 48,527 pages cited by ChatGPT, AI Mode, or AI Overviews with uncited pages from the same site, which removes the site’s overall strength from the comparison. In the table, a factor of 2.7 means pages with the feature were cited 2.7 times as often as pages without it.

页面特征 因子 SISTRIX 对此的评价

带跳转链接的目录 1.7 仅有 14% 的页面有目录；编辑类网站为 2.5
FAQ 结构化数据 1.5 在 833 个 URL 中指向相反方向，这是对小型 GEO 研究的警告
可见的最后更新日期 1.3 编辑类网站为 1.9，但电商网站为 0.7；仅 5% 的页面显示了更新日期
十个或更多外部链接 1.3 链接到来源
产品结构化数据 0.8 AI Overviews 中为 0.5，但“不是杠杆，但也不必担心”；应该保留
多个特征组合 2.1 相对于几乎未优化的页面

An experiment in the paper that gave GEO its name points the same way as SISTRIX’s correlations. Aggarwal and colleagues rewrote web pages and measured how much of a generated answer drew on them. On their 10,000-query benchmark, adding quotations raised a page’s visibility by about 41%, adding statistics by about 31%, and citing sources by about 27%, while keyword stuffing lowered it by about 8%, all on their main measure, the position-weighted share of the answer’s words. Lower-ranked pages gained the most: citing sources lifted a page ranked fifth by 115% and cut the top-ranked page by 30%. They also tried Perplexity, an AI search product, on 200 samples, uploading the source text as files rather than letting it search. The gains on that measure were smaller, at about 21% for quotations and 9% for statistics. The main test used GPT-3.5 reading the top five search results, which is well behind today’s products, so the percentages are dated even if the direction still holds.

为 GEO 命名的那篇论文中有一个实验，其结论与 SISTRIX 的相关性分析指向同一方向。Aggarwal 及其同事重写了网页内容，并测量生成的答案在多大程度上引用了这些页面。在他们那套包含 10,000 个查询的基准测试上，加入引文使页面的可见度提升约 41%，加入统计数据提升约 31%，标注来源提升约 27%，而堆砌关键词则使其下降约 8%——以上都是基于他们的主要衡量指标，即按答案中词语位置加权的占比。排名靠后的页面收益最大：标注来源使排名第五的页面提升了 115%，却使排名第一的页面下降了 30%。他们还在 200 个样本上测试了 AI 搜索产品 Perplexity，方式是上传源文本作为文件，而不是让它自行检索。在该指标下收益较小，引文约为 21%，统计数据为 9%。主要测试使用的是让 GPT-3.5 读取前五个搜索结果，这已经远远落后于当下的产品，因此即便方向依然成立，这些百分比也已过时。

The most debated shortcut has nothing behind it so far. llms.txt is a proposed file that tells AI systems what a site contains. SE Ranking analyzed nearly 300,000 domains and found no correlation with citations. SISTRIX also concluded there is “no measurable effect”, though it cautions that domains with the file differ from others in many ways, so this part of its data doesn’t have the same-site pairing. Google says “you don’t need to create new machine readable files, AI text files, or markup” for its AI features. The data agrees about the files, though SISTRIX’s FAQ structured data result suggests some markup may help.

目前最受争议的捷径背后仍没有任何实质内容。llms.txt 是一份提议中的文件，用于告诉 AI 系统网站包含的内容。SE Ranking 分析了近 300,000 个域名，未发现与引用的相关性。SISTRIX 也得出结论称不存在“可衡量的效果”，但它提醒，拥有该文件的域名在很多方面与其他域名不同，因此其数据的这部分不具备同站点配对条件。Google 表示，针对其 AI 功能，“你不需要创建新的机器可读文件、AI 文本文件或 markup”。关于这些文件，数据观点一致，不过 SISTRIX 的 FAQ structured data 结果表明，某些 markup 可能有帮助。

AI sends little traffic, but it is growing and may convert well

AI 带来的流量很少,但正在增长,且转化率可能较高

AI assistants sent 0.28% of total traffic across 74,752 websites in March 2026, according to Ahrefs. That was about 3.5 million visitors, against 345 million from Google, or roughly a hundred to one. Ahrefs describes it as small but growing fast. The true figure is somewhat higher because some visits, especially from mobile apps, get counted as direct traffic. The same Ahrefs article reports that on its own site, AI search visitors were 0.5% of visitors and 12.1% of signups. Ahrefs sells SEO software, so its audience may be unusually likely to use AI tools, and one site proves little. Still, on that site an AI visitor was about 24 times as likely to sign up as the average visitor. Some of the value never shows up as traffic. People read an AI answer, form an opinion, and never click.

根据 Ahrefs 的数据，2026 年 3 月，AI 助手在 74,752 个网站的总流量中仅占 0.28%。这大约是 350 万访客，而来自 Google 的访客为 3.45 亿，约为 100 比 1。Ahrefs 将其描述为规模虽小但增长迅速。真实数字略高，因为部分访问（尤其是来自移动应用的访问）被计为直接流量。同一篇 Ahrefs 文章报告称，在其自家网站上，AI 搜索访客占访客的 0.5%，占注册用户的 12.1%。Ahrefs 销售 SEO 软件，因此其受众使用 AI 工具的可能性可能异常高，而单个网站也说明不了太多。尽管如此，在该网站上，AI 访客注册的可能性约为普通访客的 24 倍。部分价值从未体现为流量。人们阅读 AI 答案，形成看法，却从不点击。

To count what AI visits are worth on your own site, RevScope reports when ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other assistants send visitors and whether they buy. It also tracks when AI and search engine bots crawl your pages.

为了统计 AI 访问在你自己网站上的价值，RevScope 会报告 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity 以及其他助手何时带来访客以及他们是否购买。它还会跟踪 AI 和搜索引擎机器人何时抓取你的页面。

Google’s own reporting has a gap too. It counts traffic from its AI features inside the overall “Web” numbers in Search Console. Since 2026 Search Console also has generative AI reports, which Google says show how often your URLs appeared in those features, along with pages, countries, and devices. The announcement describes impressions and doesn’t mention clicks, so you learn how often you appear, not how many visits or sales that brings. Rank tracking can’t fill the gap, since a page can hold position 1 and earn fewer clicks than it used to.

Google 自己的报告也存在缺口。它将来自其 AI 功能的流量计入 Search Console（搜索控制台）总体“网页”数据中。自 2026 年起，Search Console 也提供生成式 AI 报告，Google 称这些报告会显示您的网址在该类功能中出现的频次，以及相关的页面、国家/地区和设备。官方公告提及的是展示次数，并未提及点击次数，因此您只能了解出现频次，而无法得知由此带来了多少访问量或销售转化。排名跟踪无法填补这一空白，因为页面可能依然稳居第 1 位，但获得的点击量却比过去少了。

What to do about it

如何应对

  1. Keep the fundamentals. Pages must be indexable and eligible for a snippet. Referring domains correlated with citations more strongly than user-generated links did, and higher-ranking domains had moderately more of them, so links from other sites remain a reasonable investment, even though neither relationship proves cause.
  2. Find out who gets cited on your topics, per platform. Check your important queries in AI Overviews and ChatGPT and note the sources. Being described accurately there may matter as much as your own page. Take part in the communities those answers cite, such as Reddit, so that you are mentioned there.
  3. Write pages worth quoting. Answer related questions directly, add original data and named sources, and use clear headings. If you run an editorial site, show when the page was last updated.
  4. Skip the shortcuts. An llms.txt does no harm but has shown no benefit, AI-specific markup isn’t needed, and keyword stuffing lowered visibility in the GEO paper’s test.
  5. Judge the work by revenue. With fewer clicks to go around, it matters more which ones pay. Tie each channel to the sales it produces rather than to its rank or its visit count.

  1. 保持基础。 页面必须可索引且有资格生成摘要。推荐域名与引用的相关性比用户生成的链接更强，排名较高的域名拥有适度更多的此类链接，因此来自其他站点的链接仍然是一项合理的投资，尽管这两种关系都未证明因果关系。

  2. 找出在每个平台上谁在你的主题下被引用。 在 AI Overviews 和 ChatGPT 中检查你的重要查询并记录来源。在那里被准确描述可能与你自己的页面同样重要。参与那些答案引用的社区（例如 Reddit），以便在其中提到你。

  3. 写出值得被引用的页面。 直接回答相关问题，添加原始数据和具名来源，并使用清晰的标题。如果你运营一个编辑型网站，展示页面的最后更新时间。

  4. 跳过捷径。 llms.txt 虽无害但未显示任何益处，无需 AI 专属标记，且关键词堆砌在 GEO 论文的测试中降低了可见度。

  5. 以收入评判工作。 随着可获得的点击次数减少，哪些点击能带来收益变得更加重要。将每个渠道与其产生的销售额挂钩，而不是与其排名或访问量挂钩。

The numbers above are mainly US English, and the products change quickly, so the 2025 figures may already be out of date. Nearly all the large datasets come from companies that sell SEO data or software, including DataForSEO, Ahrefs, SISTRIX, and SE Ranking, and we sell analytics. Almost everything about what earns a citation is correlation. Three findings hold up. Controlled experiments show fewer clicks to outside websites when Google’s AI features are present, domains with more referring domains tend to be cited more often among those already cited, and we found no proven shortcut to being cited.

上面的数字主要是美国英语，而产品更新速度很快，因此2025年的数据可能已经过时了。几乎所有大型数据集都来自销售SEO数据或软件的公司，如DataForSEO、Ahrefs、SISTRIX和SE Ranking，而我们则专注于销售分析工具。关于什么才能获得引用，几乎所有内容都与相关性有关。三个结论显而易见：受控实验表明，当谷歌的AI功能启用时，点击外部网站的次数会减少；在已引用的域名中，拥有更多引用域的域名 tend 更常被引用；我们没有发现任何被引用的捷径。

Stop guessing what makes money

别再猜测什么能赚钱

RevScope connects your web traffic to your payments, so you can see which channels, pages, and keywords bring in revenue. Start on the free plan and put your time and budget where it pays.

RevScope 将网站流量与支付关联起来，让你看到哪些渠道、页面和关键词能带来收入。从免费计划开始，把时间和预算投入到能带来回报的地方。

Rather run it yourself? RevScope’s source is public. Self-host it for free.

想自己运行吗？RevScope 的源代码是公开的。免费自行托管。

Sources

来源

Search Insider: 2026 Edition
DataForSEO · Annual research report · October 2026
DataForSEO collects search and AI answer data for a living and publishes its tables and methods, which allowed us to check the monthly figures behind its headlines. It sells this data, its answer prompts aren’t explained, and its click shares are modeled. We rely on it for what appears where, and treat its click estimates and correlations as indications. Our charts are redrawn from its published values.

Search Insider: 2026 Edition
DataForSEO · 年度研究报告 · 2026 年 10 月
DataForSEO 以收集搜索和 AI 答案数据为业，并发布其表格和方法，这让我们能够核查其头条背后的月度数据。它出售这些数据，其答案提示词未做解释，其点击份额为模型推算。我们依赖它来了解什么内容出现在何处，并将其点击估算和相关性视为参考。我们的图表根据其公布的值重新绘制。

The Impact of Google AI Overviews on Publisher Traffic and User Experience: Evidence from a Field Experiment
Saharsh Agarwal and Ananya Sen · Working paper · SSRN · draft of June 2026
University researchers ran a preregistered randomized experiment on 1,065 US participants, 770 of them in the two groups compared here. Random assignment makes it the best evidence that Overviews themselves reduce clicks. It isn’t yet peer reviewed, and it covers desktop Chrome for two weeks. We read a copy of the June draft hosted outside SSRN.

谷歌 AI 概述对发布者流量和用户体验的影响：一项现场实验的证据
作者：萨哈什·阿加瓦尔和阿纳尼亚·森· 工作论文 · SSRN · 2026 年 6 月草稿
研究人员在 1,065 名美国参与者中进行了一项注册随机实验，其中 770 人属于本文比较的两组。随机分组设计使得该研究成为证明 AI 概述本身减少点击次数的最佳证据。该研究尚未经过同行评审，且仅涵盖为期两周的桌面 Chrome 浏览器环境。我们查阅了 SSRN 之外托管的 6 月草稿的副本。

AI in Search Reduces Publisher Referrals Without Improving User Experience: Experimental Evidence
Stephanie T. Wang, Jeffrey Gleason, and colleagues · Preprint · arXiv · August 2026
A second preregistered experiment, with 1,100 people, which independently supports the direction of the result. We read its abstract only, so we use it for that direction and not for any figure.

搜索中的 AI 在未改善用户体验的情况下削减了发布商推荐量：实验证据
Stephanie T. Wang, Jeffrey Gleason, and colleagues · Preprint · arXiv · 2026 年 8 月
第二项预注册实验，涉及 1,100 名人员，独立支持结果的方向。我们仅阅读了其摘要，因此仅将其用于该方向，而不用于任何图表。

Google users are less likely to click on links when an AI summary appears in the results
Athena Chapekis and Anna Lieb · Short read · Pew Research Center · July 2025
A nonprofit research organization with no search product to sell, logging the real browsing of 900 consenting US adults. It covers one month, March 2025, re-collected the summaries in April, and doesn’t control for which searches draw a summary.

当谷歌搜索结果中出现 AI 摘要时，用户点击链接的可能性会降低 雅典娜·查佩基斯 和 安娜·利布·著 · 简短阅读 · 皮尤研究中心 · 2025 年 7 月 这是一个不销售搜索产品的非营利性研究组织，他们记录了 900 名自愿参与的美国成人的真实浏览行为。该研究涵盖了 2025 年 3 月的一个月，摘要于 4 月重新收集，但并未控制哪些搜索会显示摘要。

AI Features and Your Website and the Search Console reports announcement
Google Search Central · Documentation, last updated December 2025, and blog post, June 2026
The primary sources for what Google says its AI features require and how it reports them. They are reliable on those rules, and they aren’t independent evidence of what works.

AI 功能与您的网站 和 Search Console 报告公告 Google Search Central · 文档，最后更新于 2025 年 12 月，以及 2026 年 6 月的博客文章 这些是 Google 关于其 AI 功能要求及报告方式的主要信息来源。它们在这些规则方面是可靠的，但不能作为哪些方法有效的独立证据。

AI in Search is driving more queries and higher quality clicks
Liz Reid · Company blog · Google · August 2025
Google’s public position on total clicks, from the person running Search. Google can see the true numbers, but this post publishes none of them, so we report it as a claim.

AI in Search 驱动更多查询和更高质量的点击 Liz Reid · 公司博客 · Google · 2025 年 8 月 Google 关于总点击量的公开立场，来自负责 Search 的人。Google 可以看到真实数字，但本文未公布任何数字，因此我们将其作为一项主张进行报道。

Citation Worthiness: Which GEO Tactics Hold Up Across 96,418 URLs
Johannes Beus, Julia Weissbach, and the SISTRIX Content Team · Industry study · SISTRIX · October 2026
Its same-site pairing and correction for multiple testing make it more careful than most GEO studies. It sells SEO software, covers only German-speaking markets, and reports correlations.

Citation Worthiness：哪些 GEO 策略在 96,418 个 URLs 中经得起考验
Johannes Beus、Julia Weissbach 和 SISTRIX 内容团队 · 行业研究 · SISTRIX · 2026 年 10 月
其同站配对和多重检验校正使其比大多数 GEO 研究更加谨慎。它销售 SEO 软件，仅涵盖德语市场，并报告相关性。

GEO: Generative Engine Optimization
Pranjal Aggarwal, Vishvak Murahari, and colleagues · Conference paper · KDD 2024 · version 3, June 2024
The academic paper that named the field and ran controlled rewrites of pages. It shows content changes can move visibility, but its test engine is now dated, and its authors’ “up to 40%” should not be read as a current forecast.

GEO: Generative Engine Optimization
Pranjal Aggarwal, Vishvak Murahari, and colleagues · Conference paper · KDD 2024 · version 3, June 2024
命名该领域的学术论文并对页面进行了受控重写。它展示内容变更可以影响可见性，但其测试引擎已过时，且作者们的 " up to 40%" 不应被视为当前预测。

Update: 38% of AI Overview Citations Pull From The Top 10 and 76% of AI Overview Citations Pull From the Top 10
Louise Linehan with Xibeijia Guan · Industry studies · Ahrefs · March 2026 and July 2025
Ahrefs sells SEO tools and tracks AI answers through its Brand Radar product, here matching about 4 million cited URLs against rankings in the later study. The two studies aren’t like-for-like. The 38% counts results in every part of the page; for ordinary links alone it is 37.1%.

更新：38% 的 AI Overview 引用源自前 10 名 以及 76% 的 AI Overview 引用源自前 10 名
Louise Linehan 与 Xibeijia Guan 合著 · 行业研究 · Ahrefs · 2026 年 3 月和 2025 年 7 月

Ahrefs 销售 SEO 工具，并通过其 Brand Radar 产品追踪 AI 答案，在后续研究中，它将大约 400 万个被引用的 URL 与排名进行了匹配。这两项研究并不具有完全可比性。38% 的数据涵盖了页面所有部分的结果；如果仅计算普通链接，这一比例为 37.1%。

AI Chatbot Traffic: What It Is, and How to Get More
Mateusz Makosiewicz · Company blog · Ahrefs · May 2026
The source for the 0.28% figure, from analytics on 74,752 sites, and for the signup figure from Ahrefs’ own site. It gives conflicting percentages for Google’s share in different places, so we compare visitor counts instead.

AI 聊天机器人流量：它是什么，以及如何获取更多

Mateusz Makosiewicz · Company blog · Ahrefs · May 2026

0.28% 这一数据的来源是基于对 74,752 个网站的分析，而注册数据则来自 Ahrefs 自己的网站。该来源在不同地方给出了相互矛盾的 Google 份额百分比，因此我们改为比较访客数量。

LLMs.txt: Why Brands Rely On It and Why It Doesn’t Work
Yulia Deda · Industry study · SE Ranking · page dated October 2026
A large correlation study of nearly 300,000 domains. It doesn’t name the AI platforms it sampled, so we use it only alongside SISTRIX and Google’s statement.

LLMs.txt：品牌为何依赖它却发现它并不有效
作者：尤利亚·德达 · 类型：行业研究 · 来源：SE Ranking · 发布日期：2026 年 10 月
这是一项覆盖近 30 万个域的大规模相关性研究。尽管报告未提及所采样 AI 平台的具体名称，但我们将其与 SISTRIX 和谷歌的声明结合进行分析。
